Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class CodeTools

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.CodeTools
All Implemented Interfaces:
TextEditorExtension
public final class CodeTools extends Object implements TextEditorExtension
The bundled "Code Tools" extension: whole-document line operations registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI, the same way BuiltinTextTools is. It enriches the editor for source/code files - re-indenting, de-duplicating, reversing and numbering blocks of lines - with no dependency on Swing or the panel internals.

Every operation is a pure String -> String function exposed as a static for headless unit tests; the installed toolbar actions simply pipe the current document through the matching function and write the result back, so each runs as a single undo step. A "no-op" result (the text already matches) is reported rather than silently dirtying the document, exactly like the built-in Text Tools.

    • outdentLines

      public static String outdentLines(String text, String unit)

      public static String dropBlankLines(String text)
      Deletes every empty or whitespace-only line, keeping the rest in order. A trailing newline is preserved when the input ended with one and any content remains. Pure.
